in_marathi.name: Kandarp
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kandarp हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kandarp is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'handsome' or 'beautiful'. In Hindu mythology, Kandarp is an ascetic, a celibate practitioner, and the charioteer of Lord Mahavishnu. This name embodies the traits of beauty, grace, and determination.
